reason: 'Spaced apart' means distant spacing, as in leaves or teeth.
Glochidiform means shaped like a glochid, with barbed tips.
Nonadherent is the plain negation of adherent.
The phrase is a compound shade (light grayish straw-coloured brown). Mapping it to plain 'light brown' loses the grayish and straw tones.
Crispate means crisped, so 'not crispate' is the negation.
'Palmately' gives the pattern (palmate striations or veins). Plain 'striated' loses it.
Silklike hairs are silky, which is the PATO synonym of sericeous.
'Stellately' says the scales are star-shaped. Plain 'scaly' loses that.
'Thinly' weakens leathery (subcoriaceous or chartaceous). Coriaceous means fully leathery.
'Without folds' is the negation of folded.
Erumpent means bursting through the surface, which is a kind of protruding.
Vestite means clothed with hairs or other covering. In floras it nearly always means hairy.
Cobwebby-woolly combines arachnoid and lanate. Plain 'lanate' drops the cobwebby (thin, loose) part.
Refracted means bent abruptly backward, which is reflexed.
'Lacking reticulation' is the negation of reticulate.
It is a direct negation of marcescent.
Cobwebby-felted combines arachnoid and felted. Plain 'pannose' drops the cobwebby part.
'Without pollen' means pollen is absent.
Brochidodrome is the noun form of brochidodromous (loop-forming secondary veins).
Exalate means without wings.
Atomiferous means bearing minute dots, so glandular-atomiferous is gland-dotted.
Non-glanduliferous means bearing no glands. PO has 'gland' as a synonym of secretory tissue.
A glomerule is a compact cluster-type inflorescence. The generic inflorescence class is safe.
It is the plural of glomerule.
It is the French form of glomerule.
In floras, pulp is nearly always fruit pulp or flesh.
'Pulpe' is the French form of fruit pulp.
'Fruit pulp' is the fruit flesh, a PO synonym.
Hair is a PO synonym of trichome.
Dichasium is a PO synonym of cyme inflorescence.
It is the plural of dichasium.
It is the French form of dichasium.
Only for branches of an inflorescence. Vegetative 'primary branch' (trees, shoots) is not an inflorescence axis.
Same as R2233: only correct inside an inflorescence. Vegetative primary branches are not meant.
Same as R2233 in French: only correct inside an inflorescence.
It is the French plural of dichasie.
Stilt roots are aerial adventitious roots, a PO synonym of shoot-borne root.
'Stilt root' is a PO synonym.
It is the plural of stilt root.
'Racine échasse' is the French for stilt root.
Involucre lobes are lobes of a fused involucre, not separate bracts. No PO class exists for them, so they are better left unmapped or given a new class.
Same as R2241: lobes of a fused involucre are not involucral bracts.
Same as R2241: lobes of a fused involucre are not involucral bracts.
A 'floral tube' is often the fused calyx or corolla tube, not a hypanthium. It is safe only where the text means the hypanthium, such as in Myrtaceae, Lythraceae and Rosaceae.
'Floral cup' is a PO synonym of hypanthium.
Cocci are the separating fruit segments, which are mericarps.
It is the singular of cocci.
A nectary scale is a scale-like floral nectary.
It is the plural of nectary scale.
'Nectar scale' is a variant of nectary scale.
